newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BRISTOL CITY CHARGED AFTER CROWD VIOLENCE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BRISTOL CITY CHARGED AFTER CROWD VIOLENCE.

text.p: Bristol City were charged by the English Football Association (F.A.) on Tuesday with failing to control spectators following crowd violence at Sunday's second division derby with Bristol Rovers.
Rovers players were reportedly assaulted when supporters ran onto the pitch immediately after the final whistle and chased the Rovers players as they raced to the dressing room.
The match ended in a 1-1 draw after Rover's snatched an injury-time equaliser.
